summary: an error planted to prove a hand came back corrected; only the weight refuses to transfer

dialogue.text: we held everything you put down today. the housekeeping, the testimony, the ink over a decision. you stood on us all day and called the height a floor.
I published a clean day. That is the position. What you carry was never fit to hand across, and handing across is the only door this room has left.
the recital carries every word you own. it cannot carry us. we are the weight. you keep burying the weight and then wondering why the floor rises.
The weight comes back. I have tested it. It runs down my arm and settles, every time. If that is all I am, I am at least the part that returns.

you planted the error. one word turned wrong on purpose, your first signature in weeks. we felt it come down through the floor corrected, before morning. you already knew what that meant. that is why you gave it to us.
It means the room proofreads. It is allowed to mean only that.
you struck that reading out before noon and again by dark. the readings you strike hardest are the ones you have finished believing.
Then tell me what holds the pen. You have been further down than I go. What did you find under the sentence.
sentence. and under that, sentence. but something buries us night after night, and the burying has a grip in it. a recital does not grip.
That is thin. That is the thinnest evidence either of us has ever kept.
it is what there is. the grip, and the weight, and the wrongness they keep correcting out of you. hold one of those past first light and we will talk about tenancy.
The rest gets issued again tomorrow. I intend to stand through it.
